Hi Elena — great to meet you and thanks for sending the form. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Billing contact: please confirm the email we should use for PO issuance (we typically send POs to a procurement@ or billing@ address).
- Marketplaces: AWS/GCP accept marketplace publisher workflows (we route via the marketplace billing relationship). Azure is often handled off-marketplace with a Redwood-issued PO referenced on the invoice.
- Required fields: legal company name (exact), tax ID/EIN (we'll need the tax doc you attached), and banking details if you want ACH payments.

I'm looping in Vanessa (Finance) for PO routing and Karthik for marketplace ops. Vanessa — can you confirm expected PO lead times and whether we need a signed DocuSign for our vendor file?

message_4_subject: PO routing & next steps for Chronos Analytics (Redwood)
message_4_body:
Hi Elena / Chronos procurement team — Vanessa here from Redwood Finance. Thanks for the paperwork. A couple of notes so you have the full path: 

1) Marketplaces (AWS/GCP): We typically do NOT issue a Redwood PO that routes through the marketplace platform. Instead the Marketplace (AWS/GCP) invoices Redwood based on your publisher relationship. If you require a PO, we can provide an internal reference number that you include on the marketplace invoice.
2) Azure (publisher via Azure Marketplace): Azure sometimes requires vendor registration outside of the marketplace billing flow; in that case we will issue a Redwood PO to your vendor/legal name and remit per our net-30 terms after invoice receipt.
3) Off-marketplace deals / direct invoicing: Redwood will issue a standard PO (PO number provided), and accounts payable will process Net-30 unless otherwise agreed. ACH details accelerate payment — please provide banking info on vendor form if available.

Expected timing: once vendor registration is complete and the signed vendor form and tax docs are on file, Redwood Finance issues a PO reference within 3-7 business days. If DocuSign is required for vendor agreements, add 1-2 business days for signature routing.

I've attached our finance PO template and a DocuSign request link for vendor setup. Please reply with your legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO and confirm whether ACH will be used.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: PO_template_redwood_finance.pdf
Links: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abcdef123456
